items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and retain parked-site dispositions. Four legal launch tasks remain open; source rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates are incomplete. Continue the existing evidence bundle and rights matrix; keep external outreach unsent.

Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, private-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private; retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked; keep external outreach unsent; continue bounded read-only evidence work only. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish public/commercial reuse rights; compliance is technical-only with 37 passes, 15 failures, and 7 unknowns; security and operations sweeps have no results; analytics has source gaps; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable; accuracy, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth on otherwise evidenced live sites.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked because rights to fetch, store, transform, display, cache, retain historical derivatives, alert, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize are not established. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.
